title: 威廉姆斯改口？：年内或再加息一次，此前暗示加息已结束
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: A lot can happen between now and next year, but why do you think that the Fed Bank of New York president John Williams is so confident saying that we're kind of too and done in
segments.zh: 从现在到明年可能发生很多事，但为什么纽约联储主席威廉姆斯如此确信本轮周期已接近尾声？

segments.en: this cycle? Well, he sat down with our Maria Louisa Keferro this morning and some members of the Bloomberg news team.
segments.zh: 他今早与我们的玛丽亚·路易莎·凯费罗以及彭博新闻团队的一些成员进行了座谈。

segments.en: And basically suggested that while he firmly supported the rate increase that we got in September, it was a risk management move.
segments.zh: 他基本上表示，虽然他坚定支持9月份的加息，但那是风险管理举措。

segments.en: Some people said it was because the economy was getting stronger and they had to guard against inflation coming from that.
segments.zh: 有人说这是因为经济走强，他们必须防范由此产生的通胀。

segments.en: And others, this is according to minutes of the meetings and it was risk management.
segments.zh: 而另一些人则认为，根据会议纪要，这是风险管理。

segments.en: He's in the risk management cap. He sees no signs of an overheated economy.
segments.zh: 他属于风险管理阵营。他认为没有经济过热的迹象。

segments.en: The labor markets in balance, the tariff inflation effect will fade and he says, even if energy prices stay up, they're not going to push inflation higher next year.
segments.zh: 劳动力市场处于平衡，关税通胀效应将消退，他还表示，即使能源价格保持高位，明年也不会推高通胀。

segments.en: So that gives him some confidence. And then the idea that the economy is growing, you may need a little bit higher interest rate.
segments.zh: 这给了他一些信心。然后，考虑到经济在增长，可能需要稍微提高利率。

segments.en: So he's willing to do one more. I want to home in on the energy question, why and maybe you can talk about other economists in the way they view this too.
segments.zh: 所以他愿意再加息一次。我想聚焦能源问题，为什么，也许你可以谈谈其他经济学家对此的看法。

segments.en: But why is he so confident that even if energy prices do remain high next year, they won't flow through and actually cause inflation to increase?
segments.zh: 但为什么他如此确信，即使明年能源价格保持高位，它们也不会传导并导致通胀上升？

segments.en: Well, basically, it's just a matter of looking at where your base is and the base price is right now.
segments.zh: 基本上，关键就在于看你的基准和当前基准价格在哪里。
